purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, scope limits, and uncertainty for Point Cook.
assessment: Victoria's official Vicmap Property sources provide a statewide cadastral product and public LASSI/REST routes. The public Vicmap Parcel MapServer layer exposes safe schema metadata and GDA2020 source CRS, but its advertised capabilities are map-only; the bounded exact-point feature query returned HTTP 400 and no parcel ID or geometry. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
